item.description:
### Strict Mode
A block session or a Time Limit can now be saved as **strict**. A strict one can't be stopped, edited or deleted. For a repeating schedule that holds between its windows too, not only while it is running — so a 9pm block can't be moved or switched off at 8:59.
The block list a strict session uses is locked along with it, so emptying the list is not a way around the session.
Turn it on with the Strict Mode switch when you set up a session or a limit. **Choose it deliberately: once saved, there is no way to undo it from inside the app.**
### Setup cards close from any edge again
Clicking outside a setup card to dismiss it works along the top and bottom edges, not only at the sides.
### Deleting your account
Clearing this Mac as part of deleting your account is no longer prone to failing partway.
